name: Requirement
purpose: Represent stable requirement identity, immutable revisions, revision-scoped acceptance criteria, sealed baselines and attributable revision-pinned trace links without treating tasks, tests, evidence, rules or decisions as the requirement itself.

owns: immutable requirement revisions and supersession lineage
acceptance criteria bound to exact requirement revisions
typed attributable trace-link assertions with pinned endpoints
conflict records and explicit resolution references
delegates: reusable formal rule identity and revision lifecycle to WM-KNW-013
test case execution and test-result evidence to WM-SFT-015
evidence and citation stance to WM-KNW-008
conflict resolution and approval occurrence to WM-ACT-024
stakeholder need feature design implementation observation and waiver identity to their external masters
excludes: automatic verification transfer to changed revisions

relations.purpose: Pin reusable rule revisions used by acceptance criteria without copying rule text.
Trace implementation tasks without treating task state as satisfaction.
Trace test definitions and results used in verification.
Resolve qualified evidence and citation support or challenge.
Resolve authorized conflict selection approval or waiver decisions.

operations.effect: Bind one criterion to one exact revision and verification method.
Seal a named exact revision set with authority effectivity and digest.
Append an attributable typed link between pinned endpoint revisions.
Record challenge without deleting the original assertion.
Reference an authority-scoped decision and selected revision while preserving alternatives.
End new applicability while retaining all revisions baselines and evidence.

invariants: Requirement identity and each immutable revision are distinct.
Acceptance and verification cite an exact requirement revision.
Requirement revisions and sealed baseline membership are append-only.
Every baseline contains exact revision references and a deterministic set digest.
Any baseline membership or revision change creates a successor baseline.
Every trace link pins both endpoint revisions and records asserter and time.
Task state including Done never proves implementation correctness or requirement satisfaction.
Satisfaction requires a qualified test result and evidence for the same revision.
Absence of evidence is never pass.
Failed and superseded test results remain visible.
Reusable rule text is referenced by exact WM-KNW-013 revision rather than copied.
Verification does not transfer to a changed revision unless byte identity is explicitly reaffirmed.
Conflict alternatives remain resolvable after authority selects one.
Waiver exception or approval never rewrites the source requirement or rule.
Retirement never cascades deletion to traces baselines tests or evidence.
holds: Exact Grok review and provider reconciliation are pending.
One frozen no-tools semantic audit of the reconciled candidate is pending.
WM-KNW-013 and WM-SFT-015 retain their own publication holds.
Future extraction of Baseline or Trace Link requires independent mastership evidence and registry allocation.
Package conversion and live HTTP/runtime/search/package verification are pending.
